headline: 120-store prospect fully automated and not interested; caller identifies as 'Ravi', metadata says Meera

suggested_routes.label: Human review
suggested_routes.rationale: The caller introduces himself as Ravi, but the record's rep_name is Meera. Per-person coaching and activity attribution are uncertain.
suggested_routes.output: Attribution check: confirm who made this call before using it in Meera's coaching or per-person counts. The dashboard counts it under the source rep_name (Meera) and flags the conflict; it is not reassigned automatically.

suggested_routes.label: Log only
suggested_routes.rationale: Clear 'already in place' rejection with a stated reason; no follow-up agreed.
suggested_routes.evidence_ref: C06 — "We already have many of those things in place."
suggested_routes.output: Log: not interested. Head office runs automated expense processes through their business management system.

evidence.supports: The spoken caller name differs from the metadata rep_name.

evidence.quote: We already have many of those things in place.
The essential processes are automated and connected through our business management system.
If a particular need comes up later, we will reach out.
evidence.supports: No follow-up was agreed; the prospect will initiate.

concise_output: A cold call to Nikhil at a 120+ store business. The prospect says expense processes are automated and centrally managed, and declined. The caller calls himself Ravi while the record attributes the call to Meera, so attribution needs checking before coaching.
what_established: The prospect has a mixed, largely automated model with head-office visibility, and is not interested now.
what_not_established: Who actually placed the call. The meaning of the rep's final remark about "a separate department here monitoring this" is unclear in the adapted text.
next_action: Confirm call attribution; log as not interested.
uncertainty: The name conflict may come from adaptation or a shared line; it cannot be resolved from the package.
label_check: Stored observed_outcome 'uninterested' agrees. Stored rep_name 'Meera' conflicts with the spoken name 'Ravi'.
